compute_precision_binary: compute precision score for binary classification using predictions and references lists
compute_precision_multiclass: compute multiclass precision with macro, micro, or weighted averaging over predictions and references
compute_precision_weighted: compute precision with custom sample weights applied to predictions and references
compute_precision_per_class: compute per-class precision scores by setting average to None for multiclass predictions and references
get_precision_metric_info: get precision metric metadata including description, features schema, and reference documentation
